Monero wallet RPC and daemon
============================

Components: monero-wallet-rpc and monerod v0.18.5.3 (Fluorine Fermi)
Platform: x86_64 Linux

The binaries were extracted from the official CLI archive:
https://downloads.getmonero.org/cli/monero-linux-x64-v0.18.5.3.tar.bz2

Official signed archive SHA256:
3333d0e04c9cbe3023e7e2b6dd369c407f36bb8df5b05fb0a19d7685b3d56dfc

The signed hash list was verified with binaryFate's official key:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/monero-project/monero/master/utils/gpg_keys/binaryfate.asc
Fingerprint used: 81AC591FE9C4B65C5806AFC3F0AF4D462A0BDF92

The upstream Monero license is included beside the binary. Aurum launches
these components bound to loopback, with core dumps disabled and the processes
marked non-dumpable. XMR wallet keys remain in the upstream encrypted wallet
format; Aurum does not implement or reinterpret Monero signing. The bundled
daemon is started only for the default loopback node, binds RPC and peer
listeners to loopback, disables inbound port advertisement, and honors a
configured local Tor SOCKS proxy.
